programs.title: Bad Chad Customs: Chad vs. Pinto
programs.desc: Chad works on transforming a rusted-out 1971 Pinto into a European-style performance car framed in glass  with only four weeks to work and a mountain of problems facing him, Chad risks missing a deadline for the first time.

programs.title: Downey's Dream Cars: Way Off Road
programs.desc: A look at Robert's all-original, low-mile '85 El Camino.

programs.title: Car Fix
programs.desc: The guys complete work on the 1970 Buick Skylark, and the vehicle is returned to its very excited owner.

programs.title: Car Fix
programs.desc: Work on a 1967 Ford Mustang Shelby GT 500 gets interrupted when Jared travels to his hometown of Paola, Kan., for a car show.

programs.title: Ant Anstead Master Mechanic: Rise and Wine
programs.desc: Ant hopes to sweet-talk a few bigwigs into giving him permission to take his completed Alfa 158 to the US Grand Prix in Austin  however, the car isn't done, and his arm still isn't fully healed, leaving the heavy lifting to his crew.
